courses.overview: 跨單元連結與比較練習

related.title: Airbus A350 複材客機系統工程
related.why: 比較兩個系統的負載、能源或資料介面，列出不可直接沿用的邊界條件。
related.whyEn: Compare load, energy or data interfaces and identify boundary conditions that cannot be transferred.
related.difference: 機體尺度、載荷條件、材料方向及驗證目的必須分別設定。
related.differenceEn: Aircraft scale, load conditions, material direction and verification purpose require separate definitions.
practice: 各選一個教學算例，記下輸入、輸出與單位。
對照兩課的系統邊界，說明哪些假設不能沿用。
改變一個輸入，提出量測與失效判據來核對結果。
practiceEn: Choose one worked example from each course and record inputs, outputs and units.
Compare system boundaries and identify assumptions that cannot transfer.
Change one input and propose measurements and failure criteria to check the result.

courses.summary: 這門課以公開機型或技術名稱作工程案例入口，再用原創的通用模型檢查負載、能源、量測與驗證。命名案例的實際規格、年代及取證狀態以連結原始機構為準，課內數值均不是原廠資料。
courses.summaryEn: This course uses a public aircraft or technology name as a case-study entry, then original generic models to examine loads, energy, measurement and verification. Consult the linked originating institution for actual specifications, dates and certification status; course numbers are not manufacturer data.

history.title: Boeing 787 複材與電力系統
history.text: 這門課以公開機型或技術名稱作工程案例入口，再用原創的通用模型檢查負載、能源、量測與驗證。命名案例的實際規格、年代及取證狀態以連結原始機構為準，課內數值均不是原廠資料。
history.textEn: This course uses a public aircraft or technology name as a case-study entry, then original generic models to examine loads, energy, measurement and verification. Consult the linked originating institution for actual specifications, dates and certification status; course numbers are not manufacturer data.

courses.connection: 以787公開複材與電氣化背景，連接結構方向性、電源、線損、環控及熱管理。用原創能源帳分辨少引氣概念與完全無耗能的錯誤推論。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
courses.connectionEn: Use the public 787 composite/electrification context to connect directional structures, power, wiring loss, environmental control and thermal management; original balances distinguish reduced bleed-air use from the false idea of no energy cost. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.

roles.role: 787 的製造商與系統整合者。
roles.roleEn: Manufacturer and systems integrator of the 787.
roles.business: 製造商用客機、國防航空器（含 AH-64 阿帕契）與太空系統。
roles.businessEn: Builds commercial jetliners, defence aircraft (including the AH-64 Apache) and space systems.

roles.role: 787 碳纖維複材的主要材料供應商。
roles.roleEn: Principal carbon-fibre composite material supplier for the 787.
roles.business: 碳纖維複材與水處理 RO 膜製造商。
roles.businessEn: Maker of carbon-fibre composites and RO water-treatment membranes.

roles.role: 旗下 Collins Aerospace（前 Hamilton Sundstrand）供應 787 電力產生與分配系統。
roles.roleEn: Its Collins Aerospace (ex-Hamilton Sundstrand) supplies the 787 electric power generation and distribution system.
roles.business: 航太國防集團（Raytheon、Collins、Pratt & Whitney），併入 BBN 等網路研究傳統。
roles.businessEn: Aerospace and defence group (Raytheon, Collins, Pratt & Whitney) that absorbed BBN’s networking heritage.

courses.connection: 從「Boeing 787 複材與電力系統」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Boeing 787 composites and electrical integration. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.

vendors.name: 波音
vendors.business: 製造商的 AH-64 公開產品概覽，延伸理解旋翼機系統整合與維護背景；本課限於一般航空工程原理。 作為公開產品／服務的學習關聯，不是本課的採購或承攬名單。
vendors.businessEn: The manufacturer’s AH-64 overview gives rotorcraft integration and maintenance context; this course remains at general aeronautical principles. This is a public product/service learning reference, not a procurement or contractor list for this course.

vendors.name: 東麗
vendors.business: 碳纖維複材與水處理 RO 膜製造商。
vendors.businessEn: Maker of carbon-fibre composites and RO water-treatment membranes.

vendors.name: RTX（雷神）
vendors.business: 航太與國防系統，含主動相位陣列雷達。
vendors.businessEn: Aerospace and defence systems including active phased-array radars.
